Why Noida

Noida is one of North India's best places to start a company

Noida has grown from an industrial township into one of India's largest hubs for IT services, SaaS, electronics manufacturing, media and exports. Excellent metro and expressway connectivity to Delhi, plentiful office and co-working space from Sector 62 to the Noida–Greater Noida Expressway, and the Noida International Airport at Jewar make it a natural base for new businesses.

Registering your business as a company or LLP gives you the credibility that Noida's corporate clients, export buyers and lenders expect — and unlocks benefits under Uttar Pradesh's startup and MSME policies that are only available to registered entities.

Noida-specific rules

What is different about registering a company in Noida?

The Companies Act is the same across India, but three practical things change when your registered office is in Noida or Greater Noida rather than Delhi.

1. Your ROC is Kanpur, not Delhi

Noida falls in Gautam Buddha Nagar district of Uttar Pradesh, so your company comes under the Registrar of Companies, Kanpur. New incorporations are processed centrally by the MCA's Central Registration Centre, but all later matters — annual filings, event-based forms, notices and strike-off — are handled by ROC Kanpur.

2. Uttar Pradesh stamp duty applies

Stamp duty on the incorporation form, MoA and AoA is charged at Uttar Pradesh rates and paid online through the MCA portal. For companies with small authorised capital, UP stamp duty is generally lower than Delhi's, where duty on the AoA rises with authorised capital. We calculate the exact figure for your capital before filing.

3. Your address must say Uttar Pradesh

It sounds obvious, but a surprising number of applications are sent back because the address proof, NOC and form show mismatched details — "Noida, Delhi NCR", missing sector numbers, or an old district reference. We verify that the utility bill, NOC and SPICe+ form carry the identical address, with the correct district and PIN code.

Thinking of shifting later? Moving your registered office from Noida to Delhi (or the reverse) is a change of state, which requires Regional Director approval through Form INC-23. It is far easier to choose the right state at incorporation — ask us if you are unsure.

Checklist

Documents required for company registration in Noida

Directors & shareholders

  • PAN card and Aadhaar card
  • Passport, Voter ID or Driving Licence
  • Latest bank statement or utility bill (not older than 2 months)
  • Passport-size photograph
  • Email ID and mobile number

Noida registered office

  • Latest electricity bill (PVVNL / NPCL), gas, telephone or mobile bill — not older than 2 months
  • NOC from the property owner
  • Rent agreement, if rented or in a co-working space
  • Allotment letter, sale deed or property tax receipt, if self-owned

Using a co-working space or virtual office? That is acceptable, provided the operator gives you a rent/licence agreement, an NOC and a recent utility bill for the premises.

How it works

Company registration process in Noida

Free consultation Day 1

On a call, WhatsApp or in person in Noida, we finalise the structure, capital, directors and name options.

Documents & Digital Signatures Day 1–3

Share documents online. We issue Class-3 DSCs for all directors via Aadhaar eKYC.

Name approval Day 2–4

We draft the MoA and AoA, file SPICe+ Part B with AGILE-PRO-S, and pay government fees and Uttar Pradesh stamp duty online.

Certificate of Incorporation Day 7–10

You receive the COI with CIN, PAN and TAN by email. We then assist with your current account at a Noida bank branch, GST and MSME registration.

FAQs

Company registration in Noida — common questions

How much does company registration cost in Noida?

Our professional fee for a Private Limited Company starts at ₹999. In addition you pay for Digital Signatures, MCA government fees and Uttar Pradesh stamp duty, which depends on your authorised capital. We send an itemised written quote for Noida before you pay anything. You can get an indicative figure instantly with our cost calculator.

Which ROC does a Noida company fall under?

Noida and Greater Noida are in Gautam Buddha Nagar district of Uttar Pradesh, so companies and LLPs registered here fall under the Registrar of Companies, Kanpur. Incorporation itself is processed online by the MCA's Central Registration Centre.

Can I register a company at my flat in Noida or Greater Noida West?

Yes. A residential flat can be your registered office. You need a recent electricity or other utility bill for the flat and an NOC from the owner. If it is rented, a rent agreement is also needed.

I live in Noida but my business is in Delhi. Where should I register?

The registered office should be where you can reliably receive official communication and keep statutory records. Many founders use their Noida home address initially. Keep in mind that shifting the registered office between Uttar Pradesh and Delhi later requires Regional Director approval, so it is worth deciding carefully — we can advise on a call.

Do I have to visit Kanpur or any government office?

No. The full process is online through the MCA portal. Documents are signed digitally and the Certificate of Incorporation is issued by email. No visit to Kanpur, Lucknow or any office is required.

Can you help with GST registration and a bank account in Noida after incorporation?

Yes. We assist with current account opening at your preferred bank, GST registration under the Uttar Pradesh jurisdiction, MSME (Udyam) registration and Shops & Establishment registration where applicable.
